result.title: Train for Many, Update with One: Improving Multi-Sample Reasoning via Fenchel-Bregman Posterior Learning
result.summary: Multi-sample reasoning measures candidate coverage, the probability that at least one of $K$ candidates is correct. However, minimizing the average loss of individual attempts does not directly optimize candidate coverage. We therefore formulate finite-$K$ posterior learning, which trains a distribution over solver parameters to reduce the probability that all $K$ independently generated candidates fail. To optimize this objective efficiently, we propose a Fenchel-Bregman (FB) approach that requires only one posterior draw per update, rather than the $K$ used by direct Monte Carlo optimization. FB first uses an exact Fenchel reformulation to separate problem-specific weights from the posterior update, enabling one-draw posterior updates. It then applies a closed-form Bregman update to track these weights through an exponential running average of observed failures, reusing the same draw. We instantiate FB with IVON, a variational optimizer for Gaussian posteriors over solver parameters, yielding Fenchel-Bregman IVON (FBI). Across diverse recursive and autoregressive reasoning tasks, FBI improves candidate coverage. In a matched comparison, it achieves comparable Pass@10 using 12.3% of the direct Monte Carlo baseline's measured training time per update.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将多采样推理（Pass@K 覆盖）重新表述为有限 K 后验学习：在求解器参数上训练一个分布以降低 K 个候选全部失败的概率，并提出只需一次后验采样的 Fenchel-Bregman 方法，实例化为 FBI，在递归与自回归推理任务上提升候选覆盖并减少训练时间。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究问题属纯文本多候选覆盖的训练目标，不在视觉 latent 主线上，但其「多轨迹覆盖 + 单次采样更新 + 指数滑动权重」的训练监督机制，可能可供核查于 LVR 多轨迹 latent 训练中的贡献分配与采样成本问题。
